description: Header file defining classes for E2SM control action execution related to DU (Distributed Unit) in a 5G network, including base and derived executor classes with methods for handling control actions and parsing parameters.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_action_du_executor_base
classes.description: Base class for executing E2SM control actions related to DU, providing interface for control action support and execution.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_action_2_6_du_executor
classes.description: Derived class implementing specific control action execution logic for a particular DU control action (2.6).

methods.name: get_control_action_definition
methods.description: Returns the control action definition for the executor.

methods.name: get_action_id
methods.description: Returns the action ID associated with the control action.

methods.name: get_action_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the control action.

methods.name: ric_control_action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a given RIC control request is supported.

methods.name: execute_ric_control_action
methods.description: Executes the RIC control action asynchronously.

methods.name: parse_action_ran_parameter_value
methods.description: Parses RAN parameter value into DU MAC scheduling control configuration.

methods.name: convert_to_du_config_request
methods.description: Converts a RIC control request into a DU MAC scheduling control configuration.

methods.name: convert_to_e2sm_response
methods.description: Converts DU configuration response into E2SM RIC control response.
